do_if.value: not $placeLease.$blocked and not $placeLease.$closing and @$placeLease.$station.isoperational and $placeLease.$station.people.free gt 0 and $placeLease.$station.dockingenabled and $placeLease.$station.hasrelation.dock.{faction.player}

debug_text.text: 'RR_Stasis - Relocate [%s]: %s of %s moved from %s to %s, %s left'.[ player.age, $relocateBatchMoved, $relocateBatch.count, $relocateFrom.debugname, $relocateTo.debugname, $relocateTemplates.count]

set_value.name: $candGroup
set_value.exact: if $candRanger.primarypurpose == purpose.fight or $candRanger.primarypurpose == purpose.auxiliary then blacklistgroup.military else blacklistgroup.civilian

do_if.value: $candStation.owner == faction.player or not $candStation.isoperational or not $candStation.dockingenabled or not $candStation.hasrelation.dock.{faction.player} or $candStation.people.free le 0

debug_text.text: 'RR_Stasis - Candidates [%s]: %s of %s known stations fit, from %s, ranger %s'.[player.age, $candList.count, $candStations.count, $candFrom, @$candRanger.debugname]
'RR_Stasis - Rent [%s]: %s ignored: leased %s, operational %s, owner %s'.[ player.age, $rentStation.debugname, $rentLeased, $rentStation.isoperational, $rentStation.owner]

append_to_list.name: $leases
append_to_list.exact: table[ $station = $rentStation, $stationName = {1972092402, 1010}.[$rentStation.knownname, $rentStation.idcode], $ownerId = $rentStation.owner.id, $ownerName = $rentStation.owner.knownname, $rentedAt = player.age, $paidUntil = player.age + $rentPeriod, $fee = $rentFee, $debt = 0, $blocked = false, $docking = true, $reason = '', $closing = false, $auto = $rentAuto, $warnedAt = 0 ]

debug_text.text: 'RR_Stasis - Rent [%s]: %s rented for %s Cr, auto %s, free %s, relation %s'.[ player.age, $rentStation.debugname, $rentFee, $rentAuto, $rentStation.people.free, $rentStation.relationto.{faction.player}]
'RR_Stasis - In [%s]: %s is not on %s, skipped'.[player.age, $inTemplate, $inStation.debugname]
'RR_Stasis - In [%s]: record %s'.[player.age, $record]
'RR_Stasis - In [%s]: %s of %s placed on %s by %s, %s in Stasis now'.[ player.age, $inCount, event.param2.$templates.count, $inStation.debugname, @$inRanger.debugname, $people.count]
'RR_Stasis - Out [%s]: %s returned from %s to %s'.[player.age, $outRecord.$name, @$outRecord.$station.debugname, @event.param2.$target.debugname]
'RR_Stasis - Out [%s]: %s of %s were in Stasis, %s in Stasis now'.[player.age, $outCount, event.param2.$templates.count, $people.count]
'RR_Stasis - Upkeep [%s]: %s left %s'.[player.age, $record.$name, $record.$station.debugname]
'RR_Stasis - Upkeep [%s]: %s is gone, %s in Stasis lost'.[player.age, $lostName, $lostCounts.{$lostIndex}]
'RR_Stasis - Upkeep [%s]: lease on %s dropped: station gone or owned by the player'.[player.age, $lease.$stationName]
'RR_Stasis - Upkeep [%s]: lease on %s: debt %s Cr paid'.[player.age, $lease.$stationName, $lease.$debt]
'RR_Stasis - Upkeep [%s]: lease on %s: rent %s Cr paid until %s'.[player.age, $lease.$stationName, $lease.$fee, $lease.$paidUntil]
'RR_Stasis - Upkeep [%s]: lease on %s: rent %s Cr unpaid, debt %s Cr'.[player.age, $lease.$stationName, $lease.$fee, $lease.$debt]

'RR_Stasis - Upkeep [%s]: lease on %s docking %s (enabled %s, relation %s)'.[ player.age, $lease.$stationName, $lease.$docking, $lease.$station.dockingenabled, $lease.$station.relationto.{faction.player}]

set_value.name: $lease.$reason
set_value.exact: if not $relationOk then 'relation' else (if $lease.$debt gt 0 then 'debt' else '')

debug_text.text: 'RR_Stasis - Upkeep [%s]: lease on %s blocked %s (%s), relation %s, debt %s'.[ player.age, $lease.$stationName, $lease.$blocked, $lease.$reason, $lease.$station.relationto.{faction.player}, $lease.$debt]
'RR_Stasis - Upkeep [%s]: lease on %s ended (%s)'.[player.age, $lease.$stationName, $lease.$reason]
'RR_Stasis - Upkeep [%s]: %s in Stasis, %s leases, %s places, changed %s'.[player.age, $people.count, $leases.count, $places.count, $upkeepChanged]

set_value.name: $candFrom
set_value.exact: if typeof @event.param3.$from == datatype.list then event.param3.$from else []

debug_text.text: 'RR_Stasis - Candidates [%s]: %s stations to rent, measured from %s places'.[player.age, $candidates.count, $candFrom.count]
'RR_Stasis - Need [%s]: %s asked again within 60 s, skipped'.[player.age, $needRanger.debugname]
'RR_Stasis - Need [%s]: %s needs room for %s, no station to rent'.[player.age, $needRanger.debugname, $needCount]

do_elseif.value: $needPercent gt 0 and player.money * $needPercent / 100 ge ($rentFee)Cr and (not $needLastAuto or player.age ge $needLastAuto + 3600)

debug_text.text: 'RR_Stasis - Need [%s]: %s needs room for %s, auto-rent %s (%s jumps, free %s, friend %s)'.[ player.age, $needRanger.debugname, $needCount, $needPick.$station.debugname, $needPick.$distance, $needPick.$free, $needPick.$friend]

'RR_Stasis - Need [%s]: %s needs room for %s, proposed %s (%s jumps, free %s), auto-rent %s, last auto-rent %s'.[ player.age, $needRanger.debugname, $needCount, $needPick.$station.debugname, $needPick.$distance, $needPick.$free, $needPercent, $needLastAuto]
'RR_Stasis - EndLease [%s]: no lease on %s'.[player.age, @event.param3.$station.debugname]
'RR_Stasis - EndLease [%s]: %s, moved %s, left %s, debt %s'.[player.age, $endLease.$stationName, $relocateMoved, $relocateLeft, $endLease.$debt]

check_value.value: if event.param3.$role == 'manager' then event.param3.$target.isclass.station else event.param3.$target.isclass.ship

set_value.name: $assignKeys
set_value.exact: if typeof event.param3.$keys == datatype.list then event.param3.$keys else [event.param3.$keys]

debug_text.text: 'RR_Stasis - Assign [%s]: %s not transferred from %s to %s'.[player.age, $foundRecord.$name, $foundRecord.$station.debugname, $assignTarget.debugname]
'RR_Stasis - Assign [%s]: %s as manager of %s: %s %s, current manager %s'.[player.age, $foundRecord.$name, $assignTarget.debugname, $assignOk, @$assignMessage, @$oldManager.debugname]

set_value.name: $oldRole
set_value.exact: if $oldManager.potentialskill.{entityrole.service} gt $oldManager.potentialskill.{entityrole.marine} then entityrole.service else entityrole.marine

debug_text.text: 'RR_Stasis - Assign [%s]: former manager %s of %s, template %s, Stasis key %s'.[player.age, $oldManager.debugname, $assignTarget.debugname, @$inTemplate, @$record.$key]
'RR_Stasis - Assign [%s]: %s back as manager of %s: %s'.[player.age, $oldManager.debugname, $assignTarget.debugname, $assignRestored]
'RR_Stasis - Assign [%s]: %s stays in Stasis on %s'.[player.age, $foundRecord.$name, $foundRecord.$station.debugname]
'RR_Stasis - Assign [%s]: %s moved from %s to %s as %s'.[player.age, $foundRecord.$name, $foundRecord.$station.debugname, $assignTarget.debugname, $assignRole]
'RR_Stasis - Assign [%s]: nobody assigned to %s as %s: free %s, keys %s'.[player.age, $assignTarget.debugname, $assignRole, $assignTarget.people.free, $assignKeys]

set_value.name: $dismissKeys
set_value.exact: if typeof event.param3.$keys == datatype.list then event.param3.$keys else [event.param3.$keys]

debug_text.text: 'RR_Stasis - Dismiss [%s]: %s on %s'.[player.age, $foundRecord.$name, $foundRecord.$stationName]
